environment.description: ECS Fargate task with identical code deployed under platform version 1.4.0. Container filesystem is ephemeral (no EFS). The task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with only /tmp mounted as a writable tmpfs (size 512MB). The EXTRACT_DIR /opt/app/extracted is on the read-only layer. Database connection uses PostgreSQL role 'archive_reader' configured at the RDS cluster level with: REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM archive_reader; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO archive_reader; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES FROM archive_reader; The role also has connection limit 5 and statement_timeout of 30s. Note: the DB restriction is a defense-in-depth measure for audit logging integrity; the primary zip-slip vector targets the filesystem.

config.filesystem: readonlyRootFilesystem: true, tmpfs at /tmp only (512MB, noexec,nosuid)
config.db_privileges: SELECT-only on all tables, no schema modification rights
